source_snapshot.hcqc_credential_type: AGENCY TO PROVIDE PERSONAL CARE SERVICES IN THE HOME

policy.regulatory_truth: Nevada HCQC / ALiS license identity and active status remain authoritative.
policy.operational_truth: Only direct agency/provider evidence may establish services, service area, scheduling, insurance, caregiver model, language or pricing facts.
policy.unknown_rule: Minimum visit, minimum billable hours, short-visit price, fixed caregiver, employment model and other unverified facts remain UNKNOWN.
policy.ranking_rule: Operationally verified agencies may be surfaced as candidate care partners; missing operational evidence is not treated as a negative fact.

records.evidence_summary: Right at Home's Las Vegas primary site identifies the 6757 W Charleston location and Nevada license 9703PCS and explicitly lists shower/tub assistance, dressing, mobility and transferring among personal-care services.

records.published_rate_context: Primary site publishes example rates for larger weekly/monthly schedules, not a verified rate for a one-hour daily visit.
records.evidence_summary: Visiting Angels' Las Vegas/Henderson primary site identifies the Henderson office at 1701 N Green Valley Pkwy and explicitly lists bathing and dressing assistance. It reports long caregiver tenure and custom care plans, but does not prove a fixed-caregiver assignment or a one-hour minimum.

Comfort Keepers' primary Las Vegas site identifies the 9402 Del Webb Blvd office and explicitly lists bathing, dressing, mobility, positioning/transferring, medication reminders and meal support. The same primary site describes 24/7 availability; a separate primary page states caregivers are licensed, bonded and insured.
